en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a weathered stone statue of a robed cleric or saint holding a long rectangular object, likely a cross or plaque. The figure stands on a pedestal integrated into a low stone wall with foliage and a metal fence in the background. On the wall, a small inset stone plaque bears the word "MÜLLNER". The image has the tonality and framing typical of an old postcard.
